title: Supplement Submission and Routing for Insurance Claim Repairs
content:
A supplement may be submitted on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order while work has not finished: the repair order is in authorized, in repair or on hold status, as the system's repair order record shows before submission. Each supplement attaches the class's required number of photos and takes the next supplement number.

## Routing, decided at submission in this order

1. **Field reinspection** applies when the supplement number exceeds the class's supplement ordinal threshold, or when the cumulative supplements including this one — the amounts of the earlier supplements on the repair order plus this supplement's amount — exceed the class's percentage threshold of the original estimate.
2. **Otherwise self-approval** applies when all of these hold: the class allows self-approval; the supplement adds no structural operations; the insurer's Insurer Program Agreements agreement is active and grants a supplement self-approval limit above zero (a limit of zero applies when there is no such agreement); and the supplement amount is at or below that limit.
3. **Every other supplement** goes to desk review.

## Holds

- A supplement routed to desk review or field reinspection puts a repair order that is in repair on hold, for supplement pending.
- A back-order longer than the class's parts-delay business days puts the repair order on hold for parts delay, and the customer and insurer are told within the class's delay notice business days.

## Worked routing (hypothetical Standard Claim Repair order: original estimate USD 4,000.00, percentage threshold 25, ordinal threshold 3, self-approval allowed, active agreement with a self-approval limit of USD 1,000.00)

| Supplement | Earlier supplements | This amount | Cumulative share of the original estimate | Structural | Route |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No. 1 | USD 0.00 | USD 600.00 | 15.0 percent | No | self-approval (within the limit) |
| No. 2 | USD 600.00 | USD 300.00 | 22.5 percent | Yes | desk review (adds structural operations) |
| No. 3 | USD 900.00 | USD 100.00 | 25.0 percent | No | self-approval (25.0 does not exceed 25) |
| No. 4 | USD 1,000.00 | USD 50.00 | 26.25 percent | No | field reinspection (number 4 exceeds 3, and 26.25 exceeds 25) |

A supplement of USD 1,200.00 in the same position as No. 1 would go to desk review: no reinspection test is met, but the amount is above the USD 1,000.00 limit.
